hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: Sikiana [sik] is listed in E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 as a separate Cariban language and there is a matching ethnic group with this name (**hh:h:Carlin:Cariban-Suriname**) but their language is ``a very close dialect'' of Kaxuiâna [kbb] (**hh:g:Meira:Tiriyo**:5, **hh:hv:Frikel:Nord-Para**:558). See also: Kaxuiâna [kbb].
